parole.significato: A soft knee-high boot of sealskin or reindeer skin, originally worn by Inuit and Yupik.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Yup'ik maklak (“bearded seal”), referring to sealskin used to make boots, originally derived from Proto-Eskimo *makla (“bearded seal, spotted seal”).

parole.significato: A member of an Eskimo people of western and southwestern Alaska.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Yup'ik Yup'ik (“real person”), from Proto-Eskimo *iŋuɣpiɣ, from *iŋuɣ (“human, person”).
